is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis (page 3, 5, 10).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper discusses insecticide resistance mechanisms (metabolic and target-site) in the background (page 4) and mentions kdr and Ace-1, but it does not report any genotyping data for these or any other resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports phenotypic bioassay data (mortality rates) and qPCR data for Microsporidia MB infection, but no genotype data for insecticide resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Mwea and Ahero, Kenya (page 6).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies villages in Mwea and Ahero irrigation schemes (page 6).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports new field collections from 2024.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is reported in the paper or supplementary materials.

assessment.summary: This study assesses the insecticide resistance status of Anopheles arabiensis from two rice irrigation schemes in Kenya (Mwea and Ahero) using CDC bottle bioassays and synergist assays with PBO. It also investigates the association between Microsporidia MB infection and permethrin resistance intensity using qPCR. The paper does not report any genotyping of insecticide resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report any genotyping data for insecticide resistance markers.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: The paper does not report any genotype counts or frequencies for resistance markers.
